name.ja: クレリア・フォラーネ

displayName.ja: クレリア・フォラーネ

profile.ja: ゲル状の肉体と強大な魔力を持つ魔族。この種族は姿を自在に変えられる上に大抵の攻撃は無効となるため、魔界の要人たちに影武者兼ボディガードとして雇用されてきた歴史がある。技術の発達した現代では彼らの能力も対策されてはいるが、いまだにその価値は高い。特に人間界では魔界かぶれの有力者が雇いたがる事が多く、需要が高まっている。戦闘能力に長けたクレリアも人間界の要人に雇われていたが、雇い主の事業が傾き、高額の報酬を払えなくなったことから暇を出されてしまう。魔界に戻ろうかとも考えたクレリアだが、しばらく遊んで暮らせる程度の財産はあるからと人間界を見て回る事にした。仕事となればキッチリこなすが、かなりエキセントリックかつ凶悪な本性を秘めている。好奇心旺盛で物怖じしない性格で、現在は護衛や傭兵といった日雇い仕事をしながら人間界をエンジョイしている。
profile.en: She is a demon with a gel-like body and powerful magic. Her kind has a history of being employed as body doubles and bodyguards for Demon Realm dignitaries due to their ability to change their appearance at will and render most attacks ineffective. Although modern technology has developed countermeasures against their abilities, they still hold significant value. In particular, many powerful individuals in the Human Realm who are obsessed with the Demon Realm tend to hire them, increasing the demand. Clelia, who excels in combat, was also hired by a prominent figure in the Human Realm, but was let go when her employer's business declined and they could no longer afford to pay her high salary. Although she considered returning to the Demon Realm, she decided to stay in the Human Realm for a while, as she had enough wealth to enjoy herself. She is diligent when it comes to work, but has a rather eccentric and sinister nature. With a curious and fearless personality, she is currently enjoying her time in the Human Realm while taking on odd jobs as a guard or mercenary.

text.ja: 私がクレリア・フォラーネです。護衛を主な仕事にしています。ふふ……で、あなたは私を雇ってくれるのかしら？
text.en: I'm Clelia Forane. I mainly work as a guard. Hehe... so, will you hire me?

text.ja: 人間の街もなかなかいいものね。ただで魔界に戻るのも面白くないし、しばらくここで遊んでいくことにするわ
text.en: The human city is quite nice, isn't it? I don't feel like returning to the Demon Realm just yet, and I have enough money to enjoy myself here for a while.

text.ja: 変化はあまり得意じゃないの。だけど戦闘なら任せてくれる？　私の拳は特別製だから、ふふふ
text.en: I'm not too fond of change. But if it's a fight, you can count on me. My fists are special, after all - hehehe.

text.ja: ふぅん、きみは変わった能力を持ってるのね。捕食したらどうなるのかしら？　もちろん、冗談よ
text.en: Hmm, you have an interesting ability, don't you? I wonder what would happen if I were to devour you? Of course, I'm just joking.

text.ja: 雇ってもらったら仕事は真面目にこなすわよ。でも、そうじゃないなら素で相手をした方があなたも楽でしょう？
text.en: If you hire me, I'll do my job seriously. But if we're not working, I think it would be more fun for both of us if we just acted naturally, don't you?

text.ja: 誰かに擬態するときは化粧とウィッグ、あとは服装を変えれば本人そっくりになれるの。きみにも化けてあげましょうか？
text.en: When I disguise myself as someone, I use makeup, wigs, and change my clothes to become a perfect replica. Would you like me to disguise myself as you?

text.ja: 疲労回復効果のある薬を取り込んで人に触れれば、相手を回復させることもできるわよ。もちろん毒を盛ることもね
text.en: I can absorb medicine that has a restorative effect, and if I touch someone, I can heal them. Of course, I can also poison them.

text.ja: キャラが違う……？　仕事とプライベートは完全に分ける主義なの。真面目な方が、護衛対象も安心してくれるでしょ？
text.en: My personality is different when I'm working... I like to keep my work and private life separate. If I'm serious, the people I'm guarding will feel more at ease, don't you think?

text.ja: 私は一応雌だけど、同種族で繁殖はしないの。きみみたいな人間から精子を奪って生殖するのよ♪
text.en: I'm technically a female, but my kind doesn't reproduce with each other. Instead, we take sperm from humans like you to reproduce.

text.ja: 一度対魔忍君のチンポを味わってみたかったのよね……どう、私の擬態マンコは？　人間の女より気持ちいいんじゃない？
text.en: I've always wanted to try a Taimanin's... you know. How's my fake vagina? Is it better than a human woman's?

text.ja: 白い手袋をつけたままセックスするのが興奮する？　ふふ、変態ね♪　けれどそういうフェティシズムは好きよ
text.en: You get excited when I wear white gloves during sex, don't you? Hehe, you're a pervert. But I like that kind of fetishism.
